{{Top|leg}}
'''Force euphoria''' was a state in which an individual could enter after drawing on [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] so heavily that their cells were overloaded with energy. A symptom of Force euphoria was a rapid and excited voice. When the user's body became unable to keep him or her from collasping any longer, the euphoria itself was followed by a crash every bit as severe as that of a [[Spice/Legends|spice]]-addict coming down from an overdose. When [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] kept drawing on the Force to keep fighting during a [[Assault on the New Jedi Temple|battle]] to retake the [[New Jedi Temple]] from the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], she experienced this state, as did [[Vestara Khai]] when she drew on the [[Font of Power]]'s [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] energy to attack [[Abeloth]].<ref name="Apocalypse">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Apocalypse]]''</ref>
